# Checkbox

A labeled checkbox on the Field contract, with the label to its right: pass `label`, and `checked` with `onCheckedChange` (or `defaultChecked`). Clicking the label toggles it, Space toggles it from the keyboard, the box fills and the tick draws, and `indeterminate` shows a dash announced as "mixed". With `name`, a checked box submits `name=value` with its form.

```tsx
import { Checkbox } from "@/registry/ouro/components/ouro/checkbox/checkbox";
```

## Example

```tsx
<Checkbox label="Email me new recipes" name="newsletter" defaultChecked />
<Checkbox label="I accept the terms" name="terms" required error={errors?.terms} />
```

## Use instead when

- Use `CheckboxGroup` instead for several choices under one legend that submit together, `Switch` for a setting that applies at once, and `RadioGroup` when only one choice may be picked.

## Props

Type: `CheckboxProps`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` | `boolean` |  | Whether it is checked, for a controlled checkbox; pair it with `onCheckedChange`. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Layout only: margins, width, grid placement (`mt-4`, `col-span-2`). Appearance classes warn in development; style checkboxes in your theme. |
| `defaultChecked` | `boolean` |  | Whether it starts checked, for an uncontrolled checkbox. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  | Supporting text under the label, read after it through `aria-describedby`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Disables the checkbox and fades it. |
| `error` | `ReadonlyErrorMessages` |  | What is wrong, from your server action or client check, shown under the label; the box gets `aria-invalid`. A message is text or a React node (one with a link); an empty string or array means valid. In a `CheckboxGroup`, pass it to the group. |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` |  | Hides the label visually; screen readers still read it as the checkbox's name. |
| `indeterminate` | `boolean` |  | Shows a dash and announces "mixed": neither checked nor unchecked, as a "select all" box does when some of its items are checked. It is controlled: a click does not clear it, so clear it in `onCheckedChange`, as in `<Checkbox indeterminate={some} checked={all} onCheckedChange={toggleAll}>`. The box submits only while `checked`. |
| `label` (required) | `string` |  | What checking it means, shown to the right of the box and read as its name. Required: every control needs a name. To hide it visually, keep it and add `hideLabel`. |
| `name` | `string` |  | The form field name it submits under when checked. In a `CheckboxGroup`, the group's `name` applies. |
| `onCheckedChange` | `((checked: boolean) => void)` |  | Called with the new state when it is checked or unchecked. |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` |  | Shows the state but ignores clicks and keys, unlike `disabled`, which also fades it. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLElement>` |  | The box element, a `<span role="checkbox">`. |
| `required` | `boolean` |  | The box must be checked to submit the form (accepting terms): it gets `required` and `aria-required`, and the label a marker. In a `CheckboxGroup`, pass it to the group. |
| `value` | `string` |  | What a checked box submits (`on` without one). In a `CheckboxGroup`, it identifies the box in the group's `value`, so it is required there. |

## Don't use

These are not props. Passing one fails the type check with the fix in the error, and in development a console message names the fix.

- `defaultValue`: Not a prop. A checkbox's starting state is `defaultChecked`: `<Checkbox defaultChecked>`.
- `errorMessage`: Not a prop. Ouro UI uses `error`: `<Checkbox error="Required.">`.
- `helperText`: Not a prop. Ouro UI uses `description`: `<Checkbox description="...">`.
- `invalid`: Not a prop. `error` marks the checkbox invalid: `<Checkbox error="What is wrong">`.
- `isChecked`: Not a prop. Ouro UI uses `checked`: `<Checkbox checked={agreed}>`.
- `isDisabled`: Not a prop. Ouro UI uses `disabled`: `<Checkbox disabled>`.
- `isIndeterminate`: Not a prop. Ouro UI uses `indeterminate`: `<Checkbox indeterminate>`.
- `isInvalid`: Not a prop. `error` marks the checkbox invalid: `<Checkbox error="What is wrong">`.
- `isRequired`: Not a prop. Ouro UI uses `required`: `<Checkbox required>`.
- `onChange`: Not a prop. Ouro UI uses `onCheckedChange`, which gets the new state: `onCheckedChange={setChecked}`.

## `className` is for layout only

Pass margins, width and grid placement (`mt-4`, `w-full`, `col-span-2`). Your classes always win over Ouro UI's: each component merges `className` last with `cn` (tailwind-merge), so a class that conflicts with the component's own replaces it.

Appearance comes from props, not classes. In development, a class that sets appearance logs one warning per component instance, naming the prop to use instead. A class sets appearance when, after its variants (`hover:`, `sm:`) and any `!` are removed, it starts with `bg-`, `text-`, `border-`, `rounded-`, `shadow-`, `font-`, `ring-`, `from-`, `via-`, `to-`, `fill-` or `stroke-`, or is `border`, `rounded`, `shadow` or `ring`, or has a `dark:` variant. Text wrapping, overflow and table layout classes (`text-wrap`, `text-ellipsis`, `border-collapse`) are layout and do not warn.

Alignment classes (`text-center`) warn too: set alignment on a parent element.

## Types

### `ErrorMessage`

One error message: text, or a React element for a message that carries a link or other markup.

```ts
type ErrorMessage = string | ReactElement;
```

### `ReadonlyErrorMessages`

A read-only message view accepted by fields and Form; mutable input arrays remain valid.

```ts
type ReadonlyErrorMessages = ErrorMessage | readonly ErrorMessage[];
```
